subject: Interview sprint windows — full loop availability & panel order
messages:
From: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Lim <anya.lim@gmail.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interview sprint windows — full loop availability & panel order

Hi all —

We are aiming to schedule Anya's full loop (virtual onsite) for December. We have two candidate sprint windows that work on our side next week:

- Option A: Thurs 2026-12-02, 09:00–13:00 PT (4 x 45m interviews + 15m buffers)
- Option B: Fri 2026-12-03, 12:00–16:00 PT (same structure, later in day)

High-level goals: surface system-design early, have behavioral/role-fit in the middle, and end with a short product-decision exercise. Can you confirm (within today) whether either window works for you and if the proposed panel order below needs to change?

Proposed panel order (45m each, 10m transition):
1) Systems design — Monica (lead)
2) Backend architecture / scale — Lauren
3) Product + cross-team collaboration — PrIyom
4) Culture & growth — hiring manager (TBA)

Attachments: AnyaLim_Resume.pdf (candidate), panel_grid_v1.pdf (initial slot matrix).

Anya — can you confirm your availability for either of these two days and your timezone? Also let me know if you need shorter interview blocks (we can compress to 30m + 10m breaks if preferred).

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
